name: bug-report-funnel
description: Probabilistic intake funnel: a webhook delivers a user bug report, judge-triage filters real/dup/noise/needs-info (the highest-leverage gate), then actionable reports are scoped, reproduced (confirm before you build), and only CONFIRMED defects mint a ticket — unreproducible ones go back for info, never silently closed. Each transition is a confidence gate.

phases.name: triage
phases.description: Front door: is this a real, novel, actionable defect — or a dup / noise / too-vague?

phases.name: scope-blast-radius
phases.description: Estimate how far the defect's effects reach, to scope reproduction + later QA.

phases.name: reproduce
phases.description: Try to reproduce the reported behavior before spending fix effort.

phases.name: confirm-gate
phases.description: Did QA actually reproduce it? Only confirmed defects proceed to a ticket.

confirmed.name: mint-ticket
confirmed.description: Confirmed defect → file a ticket. Emit a `<repo>.bug.confirmed` event to chain ticket-to-pr.

cannot-reproduce.name: request-steps
cannot-reproduce.description: Could not reproduce — ask the reporter for steps/context. Do NOT close silently.

duplicate.name: link-duplicate
duplicate.description: Link to the existing issue and acknowledge the reporter.

code.source: return 'Recorded as not-a-bug (noise/working-as-designed). No action taken.'

needs-info.name: ask-for-info
needs-info.description: Plausible but too vague — request repro steps and specifics.
